statusText: Tail risk low at 11%. Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Stress remains elevated at 48% on multi-decade-high long-end yields, firm crude and a hiking Fed.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON, with Tail well below the block threshold. The narrow danger window spans the 13:30Z US cash open through 15:00Z, where an opening-auction continuation would be the first meaningful Tail evidence. Existing-position management and emergency protection remain unaffected.
headline: Nasdaq-100 mean reversion intact after a fully retraced dip, with Stress elevated on 2002-high long yields
body: Oct 7 US cash closed at 31,160.08, -0.21%, after a dip to 30,904.46 was fully retraced into a close only 10 points under the 31,170.12 session high. That completed retracement is the central Tail-negative observation. One hour of Globex is observed quiet: NQ Dec26 trades near 31,411, +0.03% against a 31,402.25 prior close, inside a roughly 60-point 31,399.00-31,459.00 band with no directional efficiency, while VIX settled at 15.08 after an intraday 16.01 print. The macro backdrop is materially more stressed than the price path. FOMC minutes released Oct 7 at 18:00Z showed most participants assessing that another increase in the federal funds target range would likely be appropriate by year end, following the September 15-16 hike to 3.75-4.00%. The 10Y reached 5.36% intraday, its highest since April 2002, and the 30Y reached 5.73%, its highest since May 2002, before closing at 5.28% and 5.66%. Crude is firming again in the current session, with Brent above 101 and WTI near 89, against reported Houthi attacks and at least nine Strait of Hormuz incidents in October. Asian cash opened 0.35-0.8% lower. Under the repository contract this combination of event importance, hawkish repricing and cross-asset conflict informs Stress and Confidence rather than Tail, because no persistent one-way structure, shallow-pullback sequence or repeated extension after a failed retracement has been observed. Tail is therefore held at 11% with Stress at 48%.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding clock-hours carry published Claude assessments. Tail ran 10-14% through the Asian and European hours of Oct 7, rose to a 20-23% WATCH band between 11:00Z and 15:00Z as a trend-down phase developed into the US open, then decayed back to 11-18% as the dip to 30,904.46 was fully retraced into the cash close. Stress held a 45-54% elevated band throughout and Confidence stayed in the high band at 87-89%.
outlookSummary: Base case is continued two-way rotation while long-end yields and crude stay the dominant background conflict. Conditional Tail holds 11-15% through the Asian and European hours, rises to a 17-21% WATCH band around the 12:30Z jobless-claims block and the 13:30Z US cash open, returns to 20% for the 17:00Z 30-Year Bond Auction, then decays to 12-15% after the 20:00Z cash close. Stress tracks 48-56%, peaking at the open and the auction. The 30-Year auction with the long end near 2002 highs is the clearest credible delayed-second-leg mechanism in the window.
